title: ATLAS — Verified World-Systems Knowledge Base
description_html: Full registry of 250,053 source documents across three roots (nothing filtered) plus 173 public-record events (court rulings, sanctions, official records, published investigations, corporate records). Metadata only: paths, hashes, classes — no source-file contents. Tables: events, entities, documents, pending_claims, verifications.
about: Built by a deterministic, re-runnable pipeline; verification log inside the verifications table.
